about: Stage 3 exit facts (plan claude-docs/stage3_plan_20261026/, section 10). Stage 4 runs the frozen code (git tag stage3-freeze) and reads its brain numbers only from here, configs/control/stage3.json (knobs, frozen) and the Stage 0-2 facts. Units are in the key names. Mac = Ethan's MacBook Air sim: arena body with the threaded camera, robotd s2, the brain in the runner's process, YOLO FP32 (split ONNX) on the CPU. Board = the brain on the RK3588 (YOLO INT8 on the NPU, robotd on the board, MuJoCo body and truth on the Mac). Cloud twin runs are pre-runs only and appear nowhere below.
measured_with_commit: 3p/3ab/3c/3d at f40dcab + the batch-1 fix uncommitted (committed unchanged as e62b512); 3p rescored at e62b512 (RESET_JUMP_M); 3E and m_spin at e62b512; 3F at d0f395a (robotd on core 7, brain on cores 4-6 at nice 10). The brain, the configs and the models are the same in all of them except the 3F launch (cores) and bd12f25's board-side fixes (--start=, error report, frame clock).

runs.3f_before_core_split: runs/20261027T083323Z_s33e_s2_board (failed only on robotd missed ticks, kept as evidence)

episode_rule.delivered: 2 s after the end the target's centre is inside the tray's outer square (|dx|, |dy| < 0.15 m) and below 0.06 m; strict = inner square 0.144 m (configs/control/stage3.json episode)
episode_rule.falls: a fall does not end the episode; velstand gets up (stage0_facts getup.episode_rule)

sim_health_mac.rule: <= 2% of 20 ms steps longer than 35 ms; odometry / truth path while walking 0.93-1.07

3e_per_episode.note: every one of the 30 episodes passes the rule alone, so the batch runner judges each episode folder by it

sim_health_mac.camera_draw: the threaded camera; Mac draw p50 ~41 ms (batch 1 drew on the physics thread: 16.7% stalled, odometry 0.84, discarded)

spin_bearing_err_deg.note: 3ab ran with camera.stream_lag_s 0; 3E with 0.07 (3p m_spin: 3.09 deg mean frame error at 0.757 rad/s = 71 ms late)

park_err_3e_cm.sign: lateral + = the toy left of the 1.5 cm-left target, i.e. the robot parked too far right
park_err_3e_cm.note: grasped at -2.1..+3.3 cm; 19 of 23 misses at +1.7..+4.7 cm, and retries miss on the same side (known issue 1)

grasp_3b.last_segment: blind walk (Stage 1 decision 2026-10-23); visual inching only as the Stage 4 comparison

c_drop.rule: among d with 0 falls, the most deliveries (ties: fewer stumbles, then larger d); the chosen d needs >= 8/9

tray_3c.tray_contact_3e: 11 of 26 drops touched the rim, 0 stumbles, 0 falls

d_fall.verdict: false only because one push did not fell the robot: a fixture problem, rule unchanged (known issue 2)

falls_3d.fall_signal: the brain zeroes the move on robot.state safety.fallen only (no truth); velstand gets up by itself

tof_3d.m_tof_3p: a wall 0.20 m ahead stops in H0, H1 and the search pose; 0.30 m and 0.50 m and the tray staging poses do not

reach_3p_cm.held_toy_in_view: never (0 rows in 3/3 toys): the tray look is not blocked

robotd.rule: missed <= max(1, Stage 0 rate 6/90k x ticks)

f_3f_board.cores: robotd taskset -c 7 (MD_BOARD_ROBOTD_CPUS); brain nice 10, taskset -c 4-6 (MD_BOARD_CPUS); neither runs on the A55 cores 0-3

before_core_split.note: 4 misses at brain start (model load), 4 in early SPIN, the rest single; same 9/9 delivered

batch_runner_3g.folders: runs/batch_<target>_<backend>_<layouts>[_<A-B>][_<targets>]/episodes/<seed>_<target>/ (one episode process and run folder each)
batch_runner_3g.resume: the same command again; only episodes whose folder is a result are skipped (summary.json, no interruption or runner/scorer/brain error, sim health ok, brain log and, on the board, latency and robotd logs present)
batch_runner_3g.failed_attempts: renamed <seed>_<target>.<interrupted|infra|incomplete><n>, kept, counted in summary.json, rerun next time; 3 in a row stop the batch
batch_runner_3g.same_code: batch.json keeps the sha256 of the bundle's SHA256SUMS (package + 4 configs + 3 models) and of the layouts file; a resume with others is refused

freeze.stage3_json: frozen: no change after the tag (camera.stream_lag_s 0.07, tray d 0.21 and the rest as committed)

known_issues: 1. Lateral park bias in the blind last segment: the robot parks +1.35 cm (sd 2.17) too far right of the target spot; 19 of 23 misses at +1.7..+4.7 cm and retries repeat the side. Not tuned: the 3E gate passed and Stage 4 runs frozen code. Report it with the Stage 4 inching comparison; a candidate fix is aiming ~1 cm further left.

2. 3D d_fall: one of the 9 pushes (carrying, 3002 bus) did not fell the robot at 1.05 and 1.26 m/s; the 8 falls all got up (0.30-1.04 s) and ended with a reason. A push-fixture limit, not a brain failure.

3. robotd missed ticks on the Mac sim with the camera running (14.3 per 10k ticks in the 3ab rerun, 6.3 in 3E) come from the Mac drawing frames beside robotd; the board had 0 in 3F after the core split. Mac robotd timing is not a deployment number.
4. The cloud twin draws a frame in ~450 ms, so its streamed search sees ~2 frames/s with ~0.5 s lag: cloud pre-runs use --source probe and are never evidence.

5. 3E's one drop_missed (3007 ketchup): the second close held the toy off-centre (6.0 cm forward, 2.1 cm left in the beak, against ~9 cm and ~0 cm on clean grips); it touched the rim and landed 0.20 m behind and 0.17 m left of the tray centre. 11 of 26 drops touched the rim without a stumble; the strict inner-square count equals the main one (25).
